title: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
summary:
Kimi has introduced the **K3.1 Pro series**, featuring its most advanced 3T-class open-weight models to date. The lineup includes the standard **K3.1 Pro**, which boasts a 1-million-token context window, and **K3.1 Pro Highspeed**, which is 2–3x faster for more responsive interactions.

**Key Highlights:**
*   **Performance:** K3.1 Pro rivals top proprietary models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5. It utilizes optimized large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) to deliver significant improvements in coding, 3D creation, and financial research.
*   **Coding and 3D Modeling:** The model handles full-project builds and integrates with game engines like Unity and Unreal. In 3D design, it excels at parametric modeling and spatial reasoning. Kimi has also launched "3D Make," allowing users to preview, edit, and export 3D models directly.
*   **Finance:** K3.1 Pro achieved state-of-the-art results on the OfficeQA Pro v2 benchmark. Improvements in factual accuracy have reduced its hallucination rate from 23.4% (in K3) to 8.3%, making it highly effective for auditable financial research.
*   **Cybersecurity:** To mitigate misuse, Kimi deliberately removed offensive cyber-related data during training. While its offensive capabilities are restricted, the model is positioned as a powerful tool for defensive code auditing.
*   **Availability:** Both models are available today via Kimi.ai, the Kimi mobile app, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the Kimi API (which includes a Zero Data Retention policy). The full model weights are scheduled for release by **November 4, 2026**.

The release emphasizes a commitment to "open intelligence," providing high-tier agentic capabilities in a non-discriminatory, open-weight format.
chinese_title: Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 K3.1 Pro 高速版
chinese_summary:
Kimi 推出了 K3.1 Pro 系列，这是其迄今为止最先进的 3T 级开源权重模型。该系列包括标准版 **K3.1 Pro**（拥有 100 万 token 的上下文窗口）以及 **K3.1 Pro Highspeed**（速度提升 2-3 倍，交互响应更迅速）。

**核心亮点：**
*   **性能表现：** K3.1 Pro 可媲美 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5.5 等顶尖闭源模型。它利用优化的规模化强化学习 (RL)，在编程、3D 创作和金融研究方面实现了显著提升。
*   **编程与 3D 建模：** 该模型支持全项目构建，并能与 Unity 和 Unreal 等游戏引擎集成。在 3D 设计中，它擅长参数化建模和空间推理。Kimi 还推出了 “3D Make” 功能，允许用户直接预览、编辑和导出 3D 模型。
*   **金融：** K3.1 Pro 在 OfficeQA Pro v2 基准测试中取得了业界领先的成绩。事实准确性的提升使幻觉率从 23.4%（K3）降低至 8.3%，使其在可审计的金融研究中极具效率。
*   **网络安全：** 为减少滥用，Kimi 在训练过程中刻意删除了攻击性网络安全相关数据。虽然其攻击能力受限，但该模型被定位为防御性代码审计的强大工具。
*   **获取方式：** 两种模型现已通过 Kimi.ai、Kimi 移动应用、Kimi Work、Kimi Code 以及 Kimi API（包含零数据保留政策）提供。完整模型权重计划于 **2026 年 11 月 4 日**发布。

此次发布强调了对“开放智能”的承诺，以无歧视、开源权重的形式提供高阶智能体能力。

title: Today, we hacked what we'd set out to hack: the iPhone
summary:
At the Hexacon security conference in Paris on October 16, 2026, researchers demonstrated a series of successful exploits targeting the iPhone. 

The presentation featured several high-profile vulnerabilities, including a "1-click" exploit for the Signal messaging app and a separate attack targeting iMessage. Additionally, the team showcased a persistence mechanism dubbed "APT" (Apple Persistent Threat), suggesting the ability to maintain unauthorized access to the device. While the group revealed these demos at the event, they stated that full details and tools would be released at a later date.
chinese_title: 今天，我们攻破了既定目标：iPhone。
chinese_summary:
在 2026 年 10 月 16 日于巴黎举行的 Hexacon 安全会议上，研究人员演示了一系列针对 iPhone 的成功漏洞利用。

此次演示涵盖了多个备受瞩目的漏洞，包括针对 Signal 通讯应用的“一键式”（1-click）漏洞利用，以及另一项针对 iMessage 的攻击。此外，该团队还展示了一种被称为“APT”（Apple 持久性威胁）的持久化机制，表明其具备在设备上维持未经授权访问的能力。虽然该团队在活动中展示了这些演示，但他们表示完整的细节和工具将在晚些时候发布。

title: Kimi K3.1 scores 55 on Artificial Analysis, placed on the Pareto line
summary:
Kimi K3.1 Pro, a proprietary reasoning model released in October 2026, has emerged as a top-tier performer in the Artificial Analysis rankings. Scoring **55 on the Intelligence Index** (well above the median of 27), it ranks 4th out of 215 models for intelligence. Its high performance relative to its price places it firmly on the **Pareto line**, representing an optimal balance of capability and cost.

Key highlights include:

*   **Intelligence & Performance:** The model excels in complex tasks, including agentic knowledge work, professional document reasoning, and scientific coding. It is a reasoning-heavy model that supports both text and image inputs.
*   **Technical Specs:** It features a massive **1M-token context window**, allowing for the processing of extensive data (roughly 1,500 A4 pages).
*   **Speed & Verbosity:** Kimi K3.1 Pro is notably slower than average, clocked at **77.1 tokens per second**. It is also highly verbose, generating 150 million tokens during evaluation—significantly higher than the median of 87 million.
*   **Pricing:** The model is moderately priced at **$2.00 per 1M input tokens** and **$10.00 per 1M output tokens**, with a substantial 90% cache discount. The average cost per Intelligence Index task is $2.11.

Overall, Kimi K3.1 Pro is positioned as a leading model for users who prioritize deep reasoning and high intelligence over raw generation speed, offering a competitive price point for frontier-level capabilities.

核心亮点包括：

*   **智力与性能：** 该模型擅长处理复杂任务，包括代理式知识工作、专业文档推理和科学编程。作为一款重推理模型，它同时支持文本和图像输入。
*   **技术规格：** 具备 100 万 token 的超长上下文窗口，能够处理海量数据（约合 1,500 页 A4 纸）。
*   **速度与字数：** Kimi K3.1 Pro 的生成速度明显慢于平均水平，为每秒 77.1 个 token。该模型输出非常详尽，在测评中生成了 1.5 亿个 token，显著高于 8,700 万的中位数。
*   **定价：** 价格适中，每百万输入 token 为 2.00 美元，每百万输出 token 为 10.00 美元，并提供 90% 的缓存折扣。智力指数任务的平均成本为 2.11 美元。

总体而言，Kimi K3.1 Pro 定位于那些比起纯粹的生成速度更看重深度推理和高智力的用户，为尖端 AI 能力提供了极具竞争力的价格。

title: Local Wikipedia: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you
summary:
In his article, Ed Jefferson introduces **Local Wikipedia**, a minimalist web tool designed to help people discover the history and landmarks of their immediate surroundings. 

The tool uses a smartphone's GPS location and the MediaWiki API to curate a list of Wikipedia articles located within a 2.5-kilometer radius—a distance Jefferson identifies as roughly a 30-minute walk. By focusing on this "hyper-local" scale, the project aims to turn an ordinary walk into a process of discovery.

Jefferson explains that the motivation for the project was to fill a gap left by traditional navigation apps. While services like Google Maps are excellent for finding businesses or transit routes, they often ignore the "invisible" or non-commercial history of a neighborhood. Local Wikipedia, by contrast, surfaces niche entries—such as specific historical buildings, plaques, or minor monuments—that don't necessarily have a commercial purpose but contribute to the character of a location.

Technically, the site is simple: it requests the user's coordinates and provides a list of nearby articles sorted by proximity. Jefferson notes that the tool is particularly effective at revealing the hidden layers of even familiar environments, proving that there is almost always something interesting nearby if you have the right lens through which to look. The project serves as a reminder of the vast amount of human knowledge mapped to our physical world, encouraging a slower, more inquisitive approach to local geography.
chinese_title: 本地维基：维基百科，但仅限你步行半小时路程内的事物。
chinese_summary:
埃德·杰斐逊（Ed Jefferson）在文章中介绍了一款名为 **Local Wikipedia** 的极简主义网页工具，旨在帮助人们探索周边环境的历史和地标。

该工具利用智能手机的 GPS 定位和 MediaWiki API，筛选出半径 2.5 公里范围内的维基百科条目——杰斐逊认为这一距离大约相当于 30 分钟的步行路程。通过聚焦于这种“超本地化”的尺度，该项目旨在将普通的散步转化为一场探索之旅。

杰斐逊解释说，该项目的初衷是为了填补传统导航应用留下的空白。虽然 Google 地图等服务在查找商家或交通路线方面表现出色，但它们往往忽略了社区中那些“隐形”的或非商业性的历史。相比之下，Local Wikipedia 挖掘出了许多小众条目，例如特定的历史建筑、纪念牌匾或小型纪念碑，这些事物虽不具备商业价值，却塑造了一个地方的独特底蕴。

从技术角度来看，该网站非常简便：它获取用户的坐标，并按距离由近及远列出周边的条目。杰斐逊指出，这款工具在揭示即使是熟悉环境中的隐藏层面时尤为有效，它证明了只要视角正确，身边几乎总有有趣的事物。该项目提醒人们，海量的人类知识正映射在我们的物理世界之中，并鼓励人们以一种更慢、更具好奇心的方式去审视本地地理。

title: How is music possible
summary:
In "How is music possible," Henrik Karlsson explores the profound, transformative power of music, questioning how abstract patterns of sound can fundamentally alter our perception of reality. The essay is framed by a personal anecdote of a car ride where a Sámi joik makes the surrounding forest appear "otherworldly," prompting Karlsson to investigate why "pure abstraction" evokes such deep emotional and visual landscapes.

Karlsson examines three primary frameworks for understanding this phenomenon:

1.  **The Psychological/Biological Perspective:** This theory suggests music "hacks" our evolutionary auditory systems, using social and spatial cues (like tone and interval) to trigger emotional responses. However, Karlsson notes this is culturally subjective; for instance, the Kalash people of Pakistan interpret minor chords as positive, contradicting Western norms. He argues that reducing music to "neural circuits" fails to capture the "divine" sense of connection felt during communal experiences like choir singing.
2.  **The Metaphysical Perspective:** Citing Schopenhauer, Karlsson considers the idea that music is a direct manifestation of the "Will"—the underlying reality beneath the world of objects. While this aligns with the feeling of music revealing a "deeper truth," Karlsson dismisses it as a "tautological" explanation that merely waves away the mystery.
3.  **The Emergence Perspective:** Karlsson ultimately proposes that music is an emergent phenomenon. Much like a sand dune possesses properties that individual grains of sand do not, the vast "existential experiences" of music arise inexplicably from simple building blocks like notes and rhythms.

He concludes that music is an "unbelievably vast continent" of sound. It allows humans to bypass social defenses, foster communal vulnerability, and experience reality with a renewed, startling clarity, making the simple existence of music a "miraculous" feature of the universe.
chinese_title: 音乐何以可能
chinese_summary:
在《音乐何以可能》（How is music possible）中，亨里克·卡尔森（Henrik Karlsson）探讨了音乐深邃且具变革性的力量，追问抽象的声音模式如何能从根本上改变我们对现实的认知。文章以一段个人轶事展开：在一次乘车途中，一段萨米族约伊克（Sámi joik）吟唱让周围的森林显得“超凡脱俗”，这促使卡尔森去研究为何“纯粹的抽象”能唤起如此深厚的情感与视觉意象。

卡尔森考察了理解这一现象的三个主要框架：

1. **心理学/生物学视角：** 该理论认为，音乐“入侵”了我们的进化听觉系统，利用社交和空间线索（如音调和音程）来触发情感反应。然而，卡尔森指出这具有文化主观性；例如，巴基斯坦的卡拉什人将小调和弦解读为积极情绪，这与西方规范相悖。他认为，将音乐还原为“神经回路”无法捕捉到在合唱等集体体验中所感受到的那种“神圣”的连接感。
2. **形而上学视角：** 卡尔森引用叔本华的观点，思考了音乐是“意志”——即表象世界背后的底层现实——之直接体现的观点。虽然这与音乐揭示“更深层真理”的感觉相契合，但卡尔森将其斥为一种“同义反复”的解释，认为其只是回避了谜团。
3. **涌现视角：** 卡尔森最终提出，音乐是一种涌现现象。正如沙丘拥有单粒沙子所不具备的属性一样，音乐宏大的“存在体验”是从音符和节奏等简单基石中不可思议地产生的。

他总结道，音乐是一块“难以置信的辽阔的声音大陆”。它让人们能够绕过社交防御，促成集体的共情与脆弱感，并以一种全新的、令人惊叹的清晰度去体验现实，使音乐的单纯存在成为了宇宙中一个“奇迹般”的特征。

title: UUIDv7 doesn't have the properties you think it does
summary:
The article **"UUIDv7 doesn't have the properties you think it does"** challenges the common assumptions that UUIDv7 provides guaranteed monotonicity, accurate timestamps, and unguessability. The author argues that while these are frequently cited benefits, they are not strictly enforced by RFC 9562 or standard implementations.

The author highlights several critical limitations:

*   **Inaccurate Timestamps:** The RFC allows implementations to alter timestamps to maintain ordering. In high-load scenarios or when system clocks jump backward, the embedded timestamp can "race" into the future. For example, Python’s `uuid7()` can drift significantly from actual time if the clock is reset, rendering the "creation time" metadata unreliable.
*   **Failed Monotonicity:** True monotonicity across distributed nodes is impossible due to the limits of clock synchronization. Even on a single node, many implementations do not use persistent storage to track the last generated timestamp, leading to out-of-order IDs if a system restarts after a clock jump. 
*   **Metadata Leakage:** Because UUIDv7 embeds a timestamp, the ID inherently leaks the object's creation time. While often a minor security concern, it can be problematic in contexts where anonymity or privacy is required.
*   **Implementation Variance:** Since the RFC is flexible, different libraries behave differently. Some lack counters entirely, while others handle overflows and clock jumps in ways that violate the expected properties of the format.

The author concludes that the only property UUIDv7 strictly guarantees is **uniqueness and collision resistance**. Developers are cautioned not to rely on UUIDv7 for strict ordering or precise timing without auditing their specific implementation’s behavior under edge cases like high load and system clock shifts.
chinese_title: UUIDv7 并不具备你认为它拥有的那些特性
chinese_summary:
文章《UUIDv7 并不具备你认为的那些特性》挑战了关于 UUIDv7 提供单调性保证、准确时间戳和不可预测性的常见假设。作者指出，虽然这些是经常被提及的优点，但 RFC 9562 或标准实现并未严格强制执行这些特性。

作者强调了几个关键局限性：

*   **时间戳不准确：** RFC 允许实现为了保持顺序而修改时间戳。在高负载场景或系统时钟回拨时，嵌入的时间戳可能会向未来“漂移”。例如，如果时钟重置，Python 的 `uuid7()` 可能会与实际时间产生显著偏差，导致“创建时间”元数据不可靠。
*   **单调性失效：** 由于时钟同步的限制，分布式节点之间无法实现真正的单调性。即使在单个节点上，许多实现也不使用持久化存储来记录最后生成的时间戳，如果系统在时钟跳变后重启，会导致生成的 ID 出现乱序。
*   **元数据泄露：** 由于 UUIDv7 嵌入了时间戳，ID 本身会泄露对象的创建时间。虽然这通常只是轻微的安全顾虑，但在需要匿名或隐私的场景中可能会有问题。
*   **实现差异：** 由于 RFC 具有灵活性，不同的库表现各异。有些库完全缺乏计数器，而有些库处理溢出和时钟跳变的方式则违反了该格式预期的特性。

作者总结道，UUIDv7 唯一严格保证的特性是**唯一性和抗碰撞性**。他提醒开发者，在没有审计特定实现在高负载和系统时钟偏移等边缘情况下的表现之前，不要依赖 UUIDv7 来实现严格排序或精确计时。

title: Canadians are running out of time to oppose Bill C-22
summary:
The provided article outlines opposition to **Bill C-22**, also known as the **Lawful Access Act**, which is currently being debated in the Canadian Senate after passing the House of Commons. Critics, led by the Canadian Civil Liberties Association (CCLA) and Citizen Lab, argue that the legislation represents a dangerous expansion of government surveillance powers.

Key concerns regarding the bill include:

*   **Weakening Encryption:** The bill allows the Minister of Public Safety to compel digital services and messaging apps to create "backdoors" for law enforcement, which experts warn will compromise the cybersecurity and privacy of all users.
*   **Metadata Retention:** Service providers would be required to retain user metadata for up to one year. This data reveals sensitive information about communication patterns and locations, even for individuals not suspected of any crime.
*   **International Data Sharing:** The bill could facilitate the sharing of Canadians’ personal information with foreign agencies, such as U.S. law enforcement, potentially bypassing Canadian judicial oversight.
*   **Constitutional Concerns:** Researchers suggest the bill may violate privacy protections guaranteed by the Canadian Constitution.

The CCLA and Citizen Lab are calling for the total withdrawal of **Part 2** of the bill, which establishes this surveillance regime. The article concludes with a call to action, urging Canadians to sign a CCLA petition to pressure the Senate to reject the legislation before it becomes law.
